svg.title: Anhbnb system architecture
svg.desc: Numbered booking command, PostgreSQL outbox CDC pipeline, and Kafka worker sinks. Logos identify the tools. PostgreSQL is authoritative; Redis and Elasticsearch are supporting infrastructure.
svg.text: A booking request becomes durable state, then events and read models.
Payment callbacks and catalog writes share the DB/outbox boundary. The Redis booking lock ends after the command.
The API does not wait for these sinks to finish.
Apply effects; commit Kafka offsets after successful handling
Search uses cache / ES candidates; dated availability and final booking prices are always checked in PostgreSQL.
Docker Compose · API / worker / scheduler process roles
Scheduler: hold expiry, calendar extension and search freshness probes. Local development: single Kafka broker.
